message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is a detailed description of the **digital form interface** for adding a business registration. Note that this is a screenshot of a web or mobile application form, not a physical certificate document.

### **Overall Layout and Container**
*   **Header Bar:** A solid dark green horizontal bar spans the entire top width of the screen.
*   **Main Content Area:** A white background containing three distinct, rounded rectangular sections (cards) stacked vertically with consistent spacing between them.
*   **Alignment:** All elements are left-aligned within their respective containers. The layout uses a responsive grid system, likely a 3-column layout for input fields within the cards.

---

### **1. Header Section**
*   **Background Color:** Dark Green (`#2E7D32` or similar).
*   **Left Side - Icon and Text:**
    *   **Icon:** A white line-art icon of a building with an awning (storefront), approximately 20-24px in height.
    *   **Text:** "Add Business - UPN: 865-0775-0553" in white, bold, sans-serif font (likely Roboto or Open Sans). The text size is approximately 18-20px.
*   **Right Side - Close Button:**
    *   **Icon:** A white "X" (close) icon, approximately 20-24px in height, aligned to the far right edge.

---

### **2. Card 1: Location**
*   **Container:** White background with a light gray border (`#E0E0E0`), rounded corners (approx. 4-8px radius), and subtle drop shadow.
*   **Card Header:**
    *   **Background:** Very light gray (`#F5F5F5`).
    *   **Icon:** A location pin icon (outline style) in dark gray, approx. 16-18px, positioned on the left with ~10px padding.
    *   **Text:** "Location" in bold, dark gray/black, sans-serif font (~16px).
*   **Input Fields (Grid Layout):**
    *   **Row 1:**
        *   **Label:** "Street Name" (small, dark gray, ~12-13px).
        *   **Input Box:** Contains placeholder/text "Powder St". White background, light gray border, rounded corners. Height approx. 40-44px.
        *   **Label:** "House No." (aligned above second column).
        *   **Input Box:** Contains value "26". Same styling as above.
        *   **Label:** "Street Code" (aligned above third column).
        *   **Input Box:** Empty. Same styling.
    *   **Row 2:**
        *   **Label:** "GhanaPost GPS" (above first column).
        *   **Input Box:** Empty.
        *   **Label:** "Locality Code" (above second column).
        *   **Input Box:** Empty.
        *   *(Third column in Row 2 appears empty or merged)*

---

### **3. Card 2: Business Information**
*   **Container:** Identical styling to the Location card (white, bordered, rounded).
*   **Card Header:**
    *   **Background:** Light gray (`#F5F5F5`).
    *   **Icon:** A briefcase/suitcase icon (outline) in dark gray, ~16-18px.
    *   **Text:** "Business Information" in bold, dark gray.
*   **Input Fields:**
    *   **Row 1:**
        *   **Label:** "Business Class *" (red asterisk indicates required field).
        *   **Input Box:** Contains placeholder "Type to filter business class...". Light gray placeholder text.
        *   **Label:** "Business Name *" (red asterisk).
        *   **Input Box:** Empty. Spans remaining width (or two columns if grid is 3-col).
    *   **Row 2:**
        *   **Label:** "DA Assignment No."
        *   **Input Box:** Empty.
        *   **Label:** "Business Certificate"
        *   **Input Box:** Empty.
        *   **Label:** "Business Permit"
        *   **Input Box:** Empty.
    *   **Row 3:**
        *   **Label:** "Business TIN"
        *   **Input Box:** Empty.
        *   **Label:** "Employees"
        *   **Input Box:** Empty.
        *   **Label:** "Year Established"
        *   **Input Box:** Empty.
    *   **Row 4 (Special Layout):**
        *   **Left Side - Dropdown:**
            *   **Label:** "Active Status"
            *   **Input:** Dropdown selector showing "Active" with a downward chevron (v) icon on the right side of the box. Background white with border.
        *   **Right Side - Checkbox:**
            *   **Element:** An empty square checkbox (approx. 16x16px) followed by the label "Excluded from fees" in dark gray text (~14px). Aligned vertically center with the dropdown.

---

### **4. Card 3: Owner Information**
*   **Container:** Identical card styling (white, bordered, rounded).
*   **Card Header:**
    *   **Background:** Light gray (`#F5F5F5`).
    *   **Icon:** A user/person silhouette icon (outline) in dark gray, ~16-18px.
    *   **Text:** "Owner Information" in bold, dark gray.
*   **Input Fields:**
    *   **Row 1:**
        *   **Label:** "Owner Name"
        *   **Input Box:** Empty, full width (spanning all columns).
    *   **Row 2:**
        *   **Label:** "Owner Address"
        *   **Input Box:** Empty (left side, approx. 50-60% width).
        *   **Label:** "Owner GhanaPost GPS"
        *   **Input Box:** Empty (right side, remaining width).

---

### **Design Specifications Summary**

| Element | Specification |
|---------|--------------|
| **Primary Color** | Dark Green (`#2E7D32`) |
| **Background** | White (`#FFFFFF`) / Light Gray (`#FAFAFA`) |
| **Border Color** | Light Gray (`#E0E0E0`) |
| **Font Family** | Sans-serif (System UI, Roboto, or Helvetica Neue) |
| **Font Sizes** | Headers: 16-18px bold; Labels: 12-13px; Input Text: 14-15px; Top Bar: 18-20px |
| **Spacing** | Internal padding: ~15-20px; Gap between fields: ~10-15px; Gap between cards: ~20px |
| **Corner Radius** | Cards/Inputs: 4px - 6px |
| **Icons** | Outline style (stroke-based), 16-20px, dark gray or white |
| **Required Indicator** | Red asterisk (*) |

**Note:** This interface represents a data entry form for the Ghana Revenue Authority (GRA) or similar municipal business registration system, indicated by references to "GhanaPost GPS," "Business TIN," and "DA Assignment No." The form captures location, business details, and owner information to generate a business registration certificate/permit.
